description: Shared fixed-aspect 'document artifact' rendering pattern for Certificates List / Certificate Detail — the weakest evidentiary basis in the screen inventory (no showcase mockup, no dedicated component spec beyond CertificateCard's own base table).

structure.list: CertificateCard grid, 2-3 column cap even at Large Desktop
structure.detail: single fixed-aspect certificate artifact (like a document) — centers and scales down on narrow viewports without cropping, never stretches to fill the viewport unnaturally wide on Desktop

contentDirectionException: The certificate's OWN rendered content (name, course title) follows the certificate's authored language direction, which may be LTR regardless of the app's current UI direction — surrounding chrome (Share button, back affordance) follows normal RTL. See design-to-code/shared/localization.json#/certificateException.
accessibilityRule: certificate text content (name, course, date) must be available to screen readers as real text, even if the visual rendering is image-based.
